## [The product is great but the overall…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64403051746ca7dfea0cbfa0)
The product is great but the overall shipping experience was lack luster. The up charge for shipping would make you think that you would receive the product in a timely manner or receive updates. My money was taken and I was given no additional information until I reached out about 10 days later. Once I reached out customer service was very prompt and had my package shipped out the next day which was great but makes me wonder if they would have sent it out earlier if I complained sooner.

April 5, 2023

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 20, 2023

Hi Kellar,

Thank you for reaching out. We're sorry to hear that shipping took longer than expected and we will share this feedback with our warehouse team to further review. We're glad that you're happy with the product you received and we hope that you will continue to shop with us in the future. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
